desc: Identify the minimax distance as an ultrametric and select the incremental Kruskal DSU count-matching approach.

Implement the complete Python solution: parse input, count A/B occurrences, sort edges by weight, DSU with unmatched A/B counters, on each successful union at weight w match min(total_A,total_B) at cost w, and print the accumulated answer.
Verify the code on the provided samples and edge cases (duplicates, equal-weight edges, K=1, large weights) without hardcoding sample outputs.
